title: A limit with the latest reset that the port accepts, 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999999999Z, rounded up into the year 10000, which Instant refuses, so the command returned invalid instead of applying the 7-day cap
resolution: SlotLimitReport carries the reset as epoch milliseconds, and cooldownAfterLimit caps it against the database time before it becomes an Instant; a test parses the reset with parseHarnessEvent and applies it through the command, and fails before the fix with invalid; design decision 8 says so.

title: The 7-day cap contradicted the harness-account-pools requirement "Least-loaded selection with cooldown" and its scenario "Limit with reset time", which forbid new sessions until the reported reset
resolution: A MODIFIED delta of the requirement caps the cooldown at 7 days, keeps every scenario, narrows "Limit with reset time" to a reset within the cap, and adds "Limit with reset time past the cap"; the proposal names the capability, and an archive in a scratch copy validates strictly.

title: The limit command made three applications in all, the first and two rereads, although the coordinator's answer Q6 accepted three rereads
resolution: SLOT_LIMIT_REREADS (3) replaces SLOT_LIMIT_APPLICATIONS, so the first application is followed by up to three rereads; tests for success after the third conflict and for conflict after four applications fail before the fix; design decision 9, answer Q6, the proposal, and contract section 12 say so.

title: The remaining gates of verification.md listed review pass 2 as unconditional, although it runs only after a pass 1 with a Medium or worse finding
resolution: The remaining gates make pass 2 conditional on a Medium or worse finding of pass 1, as pass 3 is on pass 2.
